name: code-review
description: Review uncommitted changes and report risks before anything is committed.
steps: read the diff (never commit, never push)
flag security risks: secrets, unsafe blocks, permission changes
summarize: safe to commit, needs work, or blocked with reasons
validation: verdict is one of safe/needs-work/blocked with file references
failure_recovery: review file-by-file and mark unreadable files explicitly
cautions: read-only review: never commit, push, stash, or reset anything
never print full secret values; reference variable names only
never approve your own high-risk changes silently
